title: Towards Robust Partial-Edit Deepfake Localization: An edit and Generator Conditioned Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.26903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Partial-edit deepfake localization aims to identify manipulated regions within otherwise authentic speech. Recent systems report strong overall results, but aggregate scores do not reveal whether this performance holds across different editing conditions. In this work, we present an edit- and generator-conditioned analysis of Segment-Aware Localization (SAL) using WavLM-Large and XLS-R representations on the VoiceCraft and SSR-Speech subsets of PartialEdit. We categorize edits along three transcript-derived axes, namely content, meaning change, and editing operation, and evaluate each generator separately. While both representations achieve strong overall performance, localization is noticeably weaker on SSR-Speech. From our experiments, we found that the deletion is the hardest operation, and deletions produced by SSR-Speech are the most challenging condition for both representations. translated_title: 迈向鲁棒的部分编辑深度伪造定位：一种基于编辑与生成器条件的分析
translated_abstract: 部分编辑深度伪造定位旨在识别原本真实的语音中被篡改的区域。近期的系统报告了强劲的总体结果，但聚合分数无法揭示这种性能在不同编辑条件下是否依然成立。在本工作中，我们在PartialEdit的VoiceCraft和SSR-Speech子集上，使用WavLM-Large和XLS-R表示，对分段感知定位（SAL）进行了基于编辑与生成器条件的分析。我们沿三个由转录文本派生的维度对编辑进行分类，即内容、意义变化和编辑操作，并分别评估每个生成器。尽管两种表示都取得了强劲的总体性能，但在SSR-Speech上的定位明显较弱。实验发现，删除是最困难的操作，而由SSR-Speech生成的删除对两种表示而言都是最具挑战性的条件。相比之下，编辑内容、意义变化和句子（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文首次对部分编辑深度伪造定位进行了基于编辑类型与生成器条件的细粒度分析，发现删除操作——尤其是SSR-Speech生成的删除——是定位中最具挑战性的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an edit- and generator-conditioned analysis of partial-edit deepfake localization, showing that deletions—especially those generated by SSR-Speech—are the most challenging condition for both WavLM-Large and XLS-R representations.
